description:
FOUND 2026-08-12 while building the nodalised steam generator for htgr_sim_v1.

FILE: crates/tuas_boussinesq_solver/src/lib/array_control_vol_and_fluid_component_collections/one_d_solid_array_with_lateral_coupling/constructors.rs:226 (new_cylindrical_shell).

The constructor computes the array cross-section correctly as the annulus:
    let cross_sectional_area = PI*outer_diameter^2/4 - PI*inner_diameter^2/4;
but then builds its back/front boundary control volumes with
    SingleCVNode::new_cylinder(node_length, inner_diameter, ...)
which (single_control_vol/mod.rs:349) computes volume = PI*d^2/4 * z for a SOLID cylinder of the INNER diameter.

So back_single_cv.mass_control_volume and .volume are those of a solid rod of the bore, not of the tube wall. The error does not vanish as the wall thickness goes to zero -- it goes to the full bore volume. For a 19 mm OD / 14 mm ID tube the end CVs carry 1.19x the correct metal, and for a thinner wall it is unbounded.

SCOPE OF THE IMPACT: advance_timestep() solves the interior temperatures from rho_cp * volume_fraction * (total_length * xs_area), which uses the CORRECT annular xs_area, so the solved temperature array is unaffected. The wrong mass reaches only back_single_cv / front_single_cv, i.e. anything using the axial CV-to-CV or CV-to-BC linking in axial_connection/.

WORKAROUND USED: examples/htgr_sim_v1/physics/steam_generator.rs uses new_block() with an equivalent rectangular section carrying the aggregate annular metal area of the whole 90-tube bundle, which is also the physically meaningful number for a bundle.

SUGGESTED FIX: give SingleCVNode a new_cylindrical_shell constructor, or pass the annular volume through. NOT fixed here -- tuas_boussinesq_solver is outside the scope granted for that task.
title: TUAS SolidColumn::new_cylindrical_shell builds its end control volumes from a SOLID rod of the bore

description:
Write /agent-docs/ at the workspace root: AGENTS.md, _INDEX.md, and <crate>.api.md for each selected crate. FLAT -- no subdirectories, because the upload dialog takes files but not folders.

Add /agent-docs/ to .gitignore with a comment in the style of the existing entries (say what it is, that it is regenerable, and which command regenerates it).

The directory must be safe to delete and regenerate. Clear it on each run rather than merging into whatever was there before, so a crate dropped from the selection does not linger and get uploaded by accident.
title: agent-docs: flat per-crate output dir + gitignore
